''1ˢᵗ – 2ⁿᵈ'' - BiscuitTurtleKid & KnownSH |difficulty = Normal |length_measurement = 00:51.84 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Chess Board''', as the name suggests, is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a chess board. The map has been remade several times since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Chess Board''' takes place on a marble chess board. The board appears on a wooden table, with red cloth on top of the table. The table itself appears in the middle of a black void. The chessboard is a standard affair, with alternating black and white square, surrounded by a grey border. Various enemy pieces of white and black can be seen, with enemies from the game representing real-life pieces. Some pieces have been destroyed. Playing cards can also be seen on the chess board. The grey marble path begins at a portal near the black piece legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. It meanders a fair bit around all the pieces on the board until it reaches the portal near the white piece legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Chess Board''' was similar to the first version, except the board was made to be much smaller. The green path started and ended at portals with two Robloxian kings behind them. This map had quite a few turns, but they do not deviate from the main path too much. This meant that the path was quite straight. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Chess Board''' was a large chess board, on top of a wooden stand. The chessboard was a standard affair, with alternating black and white squares. The chess pieces were Robloxians holding swords or rocket launchers. There were also two pieces with no weapon, but only a crown. The green path started and ended at portals. It took relatively long straights, but there were some corners near the middle and end of the map. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Chess Board}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *This path takes fairly long detours around the chess pieces. This means that towers with long range, like the [[Turret]], are recommended. **If you can find good spots to place them, the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite useful on this map. **Because of the long detours, [[units]], like the [[Railgun Tank]], can shoot at enemies far ahead of it without the risk of it being destroyed. *You can place cliff towers on the chess pieces and cards. **Be aware of the little space to place cliff towers, especially in the middle of the map. **Some chess pieces do not allow for cliff towers to be placed on them. **To allow cliff towers to reach the entire map, the [[DJ Booth]] is recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Chessboard.png|First version (18 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) ChessBoard.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|View}} ChessB.png|First version (18 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) CBView.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} OFFICIAL Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|First version in the game trailer. OFFICIAL Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2|First version in the game trailer. Zerotwo but in roblox with tower defense simulator|Second version in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} ChessBoardDI.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *Before being remade in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], '''Chess Board''' was one of the longest in the game. **After being remade in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], '''Chess Board''' was one of the shortest in the game, only being beaten by maps such as [[Badlands]]. *After being remade in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], '''Chess Board''' was the first map where some of the corners were not perpendicular to each other. **Prior to the [[Release v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the only other map to have this feature was [[Polluted Wasteland]]. *While '''Chess Board''' was remade in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], it was mostly remade to reduce the size of the map. This was unlike some other maps which received a completely makeover. *The size of the first two versions of the chess board on this map was 10x10 squares. However, a chess board size in real life should be 8x8 squares. **The chess board size currently on this map is 8x8 squares, identical to real life. *Every chess piece on the map represents a real life chess piece. **The legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] is the king. **The [[Fallen Swordmaster]] is the queen. **The [[Hidden Boss]]es are the bishops. **The legacy [[Templar]] is the rook. **The legacy [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]]es are the knights. **The [[Normal]]s are the pawns. *In this position white is winning the game ==Update History== *'''18 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.1]] **'''Chess Board''' added. *'''29 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.3|BETA v1.3.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|OldNormal}} to {{Color|Insane}}. *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Insane}} to {{Color|Hard}}. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|Hard}} difficulty removed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Chess Board''' remade. **Made playable on [[Versus]] mode. *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **No longer playable on [[Versus]] mode. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Hard}} difficulty added. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Chess Board''' remade. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Hard}} to {{Color|Normal}}. {{MapNavBox}}
